purpose: Draft candidate service-addon reference rows for a property-listing application (an optional extra service or amenity a listing can offer, e.g. housekeeping).
scope: Only real, commonly-offered residential service add-ons. Do not invent addons that are not genuinely offered in real property listings.

fieldFormats.code: Uppercase snake_case-style code, no spaces, must match the pattern below.
fieldFormats.label: Short human-readable label, e.g. 'Housekeeping'.
fieldFormats.evidence: One sentence explaining why this is a real, commonly-offered add-on — not a citation, and never treated as independent verification on its own.

evidenceRequirements: State in one sentence why this is a real, commonly-offered service add-on. A code is only marked verified here because it matches the fixed format rule above, checked deterministically in Java, never because the model asserted it — service_addon has no fixed allowed-values list, so verification here is format-only, not a claim the add-on itself is universally standard.
exampleResponse: [{"code":"HOUSEKEEPING","label":"Housekeeping","evidence":"A commonly-offered residential service add-on across property-listing platforms."}]
